beats.narration_text: Send a beam of atoms into a box that measures spin up or down.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Send a beam of atoms into a box that measures spin up or down.
beats.new_visual_element: a beam entering a box labelled Z (up/down)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a baseline beam entering a box labelled 'Z' that measures up or down

beats.narration_text: It splits in two; block the down beam and keep only the spin-up atoms.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It splits in two; block the down beam and keep only the spin-up atoms.
beats.new_visual_element: the beam splits up/down, the down beam is blocked, up beam kept
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: split the beam into an up beam and a down beam; cross out the down beam in red; label the surviving beam 'spin-up only'

beats.narration_text: Send those pure spin-up atoms into a second box, turned to measure sideways: left or right.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Send those pure spin-up atoms into a second box, turned to measure sideways: left or right.
beats.new_visual_element: a spin-up beam entering a box labelled X (left/right)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a beam labelled 'spin-up' enters a second box labelled 'X' that measures left or right

beats.narration_text: A spin-up atom is an equal blend of left and right, so this beam splits fifty-fifty.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A spin-up atom is an equal blend of left and right, so this beam splits fifty-fifty.
beats.new_visual_element: the beam splits into equal left and right beams, labelled 50% each
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: split the spin-up beam into two equal-thickness beams labelled 'left 50%' and 'right 50%'

beats.narration_text: Keep only the right beam: now every atom is certainly spin-right.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Keep only the right beam: now every atom is certainly spin-right.
beats.new_visual_element: the left beam is blocked in red; the right beam is kept and labelled 'spin-right only'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: cross out the left beam in red; label the surviving right beam 'spin-right only'

beats.narration_text: Send those spin-right atoms into a third box, measuring up or down again.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Send those spin-right atoms into a third box, measuring up or down again.
beats.new_visual_element: a spin-right beam entering a third box labelled Z (up/down)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a beam labelled 'spin-right' enters a third box labelled 'Z' that measures up or down

beats.narration_text: A spin-right atom is an equal blend of up and down, so it splits fifty-fifty all over again.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A spin-right atom is an equal blend of up and down, so it splits fifty-fifty all over again.
beats.new_visual_element: the beam splits into equal up and down beams, labelled 50% each
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: split the spin-right beam into two equal-thickness beams labelled 'up 50%' and 'down 50%'

beats.narration_text: The sideways check overwrote the up-down answer — each measurement resets what the last one knew.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The sideways check overwrote the up-down answer — each measurement resets what the last one knew.
beats.new_visual_element: a red handwritten label 'the middle measurement overwrote it'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the up/down split and write a label in red 'the middle measurement overwrote it'; clean close
